name: atelier-mobile
description: Android (APK) build of Atelier — wraps the same web app in /atelier with Capacitor.

scripts.android:init: npm run build:web && cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
